notes: Now called IG Outreach: find leads, send the messages and see who replied, in one app
New Send screen: every lead gets its message, you can edit it, and the app sends them slowly inside a daily limit
Replies are found by reading your Instagram inbox, and counted on the new Statistics screen
Statistics: leads found, messages sent today and this week, replies, reply rate, a chart of the last 14 days
The app stops by itself if Instagram pushes back, to protect your account
